svg.title: Vertical paired bar chart of GitHub declared durations against reported customer impact for four incidents in August and September 2026
svg.desc: Four incidents listed vertically, each with a declared bar and an impact bar: 6 August, 10 hours 42 minutes against about 9 hours; 17 August, 7 hours 35 minutes against 6 hours 44 minutes; 13 September, 1 hour 28 minutes against about 2 hours; 28 September, 52 minutes against 2 hours 45 minutes.
svg.text: Bars use each report’s own duration statements.
